description: This PHP source file appears to be part of a SugarCRM module, containing functions for generating JavaScript code that defines field definitions and dropdown menus related to email templates. It interacts with various beans (data objects) and external variables, aiding in dynamic UI generation for email template management.

methods.name: generateFieldDefsJS2
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript variable containing field definitions for email templates, filtering out certain fields based on their type or name, and encoding the result in JSON format.
